name: CIN Heavyweight Title
epitaph: The promotion's top prize, vacant at its opening and first won by Mac Rollins in the ladder-match final of a sixteen-man, one-night tournament on 30 June 2001.

name: CIN Golden State Heritage Title
epitaph: The promotion's secondary title, first announced as the Southern (California) Heritage Title and set to be decided in a fifteen-man battle royal at X-Rated in July 2001.

name: CIN Hollywood Title
epitaph: A television title the promotion recognised from its opening but kept vacant, pending the size of its roster.
